# HiCloud
> HiCloud provides cloud infrastructure, hosting, and related technology services for businesses and developers.

HiCloud appears to offer cloud and hosting services, but publicly accessible documentation and developer resources are limited. This llms.txt emphasizes the main site areas and likely support and product entry points that help orient language models to the site.

## Main
- [Home](https://www.hicloud.com/): Main entry point for HiCloud products, services, and company information.
- [About](https://www.hicloud.com/about): Overview of the company, mission, and service background.
- [Contact](https://www.hicloud.com/contact): Contact information for sales, support, and general inquiries.
- [Support](https://www.hicloud.com/support): Central support area for customer help and service assistance.

## Products
- [Cloud Services](https://www.hicloud.com/cloud): Overview of cloud infrastructure and hosted service offerings.
- [Hosting](https://www.hicloud.com/hosting): Information about hosting plans and managed hosting capabilities.
- [Servers](https://www.hicloud.com/servers): Dedicated or virtual server offerings for business workloads.
- [Storage](https://www.hicloud.com/storage): Storage-related services for backup, retention, and data access.
- [Networking](https://www.hicloud.com/networking): Network connectivity and infrastructure service information.

## Solutions
- [Business Solutions](https://www.hicloud.com/solutions): Solution-oriented overview for different customer and workload needs.
- [Enterprise](https://www.hicloud.com/enterprise): Enterprise-focused infrastructure and managed service offerings.
- [Small Business](https://www.hicloud.com/small-business): Services tailored to smaller organizations and growing teams.
- [Disaster Recovery](https://www.hicloud.com/disaster-recovery): Business continuity and recovery-oriented service information.

## Customer Access
- [Login](https://www.hicloud.com/login): Customer login for account access and service management.

- [Billing](https://www.hicloud.com/billing): Billing and payment management for customer services.
